sql: select t.tag, (select count(*) from experiment_deployment_arms da join experiment_deployments d on d.id = da.deployment_id join experiment_epochs ep on ep.id = d.epoch_id where da.strategy_tag = t.tag and d.ended_at is null and ep.ended_at is null) as active_arms, (select count(*) from live_orders o where o.strategy = t.tag and o.status in ('resting','submitted','open')) as open_live_orders, (select coalesce(sum(case when coalesce(p.quantity,0) <> 0 then 1 else 0 end),0) from (select distinct market_ticker from live_orders where strategy = t.tag and status = 'filled') f join lateral (select p2.quantity from positions p2 where p2.market_ticker = f.market_ticker order by p2.captured_at desc limit 1) p on true) as nonzero_positions, (select max(created_at) from paper_trades pt where pt.strategy = t.tag) as last_paper from (values ('mmsellA4'),('mmsellA5'),('Lmmsell8'),('Lmmsell10'),('mmsell9')) as t(tag) order by 1
